name: Northloom Apparel
products: Everyday clothing basics: heavy cotton tees, loopback hoodies, chinos, waxed overshirts, knitwear and a few accessories, priced $24-$178.
customers: 25-40 year olds who want durable, understated clothing and dislike fast fashion.
goal: Watch how similar online clothing brands price, launch and promote products so we can react without discounting our brand.
brand: Calm, plain-spoken, undyed and earth-tone palette, lifetime repair service.
competitors: Harbor & Pine, Kinfolk Row, Tidewear Co
